paper.title: OpenAssistant Conversations -- Democratizing Large Language Model Alignment
paper.statement: We release our code and data under a fully permissive licence.

terms_of_record.scope: SFT language data from human-written conversation paths only: no message marked synthetic or carrying a model_name

terms_finding: At this revision the repository lists no LICENSE file. README.md (10,606 bytes, SHA-256 52bd472cf3cae04a4b21ecd5316f929741c47d991d4763b041c3a94de072dc31) states the license only as a metadata label, front-matter line 2 'license: apache-2.0'; its text has no license or contributor terms. The collection portal's contributor terms (LAION-AI/Open-Assistant commit f1e6ed9526f5817531f3ab85441a40b3671ddccb, website/src/components/ToS.tsx, sections 2.1 and 2.2) grant no license and describe the collected text as used for scientific purposes. The README links the dataset paper, Köpf et al., arXiv:2304.07327 (v2, 2023-10-31), whose abstract states: 'We release our code and data under a fully permissive licence.' On 2026-10-26 the owner accepted the card's Apache-2.0 label plus the paper as the terms of record, for human-written conversation paths only; see docs/sft-data.md.
